## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

RecordedRaceSyncService — core-domain/.../sync/RecordedRaceSyncService.kt, sync()

## Trigger

markSent failing inside sync()'s loop — observed

## Today

sync() calls raceRecordingRepository.markSent(race.id, at) at line 52
and discards its Result. markSent's own contract (RaceRecordingRepository.kt)
says it fails when raceId carries no stored race. When that happens the
loop carries on to the next race and, once the loop ends, sets
stateFlow.value to RecordedRaceSyncState.Success(at) regardless.
RecordedRaceSyncState.Failure (RecordedRaceSyncState.kt) is a bare
object — it carries no field to say which race a stop happened on.

## Expected

sync() checks the Result markSent returns. On failure, it stops the
loop immediately, sets stateFlow.value to a Failure state that carries
the id of the race markSent failed on, and does not report Success.
RecordedRaceSyncState.Failure must be changed to carry that raceId
(from a bare object to a value holding it) for the state to say which
race the sync stopped on.

## Searched

markSent, RecordedRaceSyncState.Failure, sync(), RecordedRaceSyncService
